purpose: Use a current general-purpose LLM to identify source-stated facts, results, hypotheses, methods, implications and assumptions before compression. Do not build or train a separate discourse tagger unless project-specific evaluation later justifies it.
boundaries: This is a research-informed design proposal, not a measured PK/PD extraction system or activated runtime rule pack.
The label definitions and prompts below are our proposed adaptation, not a verbatim prompt from any cited paper.
Compression preserves project facts, assumptions, objectives and original requirements; Project Rules Agent owns formal rule interpretation and publication.
External research justifies extraction design. It does not silently supply facts, assumptions, model parameters or requirements to the user's proposal.
All prior scientific-preservation requirements remain applicable; this file does not replace the complete CC005 detail profile or prior rule-by-rule review decisions.

citation_method.measure: cited_by_count for the explicitly identified work record
limitations: Counts are database-specific snapshots, not Google Scholar or Scopus totals.
Conference, journal and preprint records may be split; counts were not added across versions.
A count of zero means zero citations indexed on this record, not proof of no citations anywhere.
Citation count measures uptake, not extraction accuracy or fitness for this task.
Semantic Scholar requests were rate-limited; no cross-database citation total is claimed.

sources.title: Structured information extraction from scientific text with large language models
sources.read_scope: Introduction and approach sections of the full paper.
sources.useful_component: Joint extraction of entities and their relations into a defined structured representation.
sources.transfer_limit: The original study fine-tunes models for materials-science extraction. It does not validate a prompt-only classifier for our scientific discourse labels.

sources.title: Extracting accurate materials data from research papers with conversational language models and prompt engineering
sources.read_scope: Results and methods, including extraction stages, follow-up questions and Table 1.
sources.useful_component: Relevance screening, structured extraction, explicit missing answers and targeted follow-up verification.
sources.observed_result: For the paper's GPT-4 bulk-modulus extraction setting, reported precision was 90.8% and recall was 87.7%. These are not expected accuracies for our project.
sources.transfer_limit: Its number-based sentence filter, materials-specific task and retained conversation design should not be copied wholesale. Qualitative assumptions and requirements may contain no numbers.

sources.title: GoLLIE: Annotation Guidelines Improve Zero-Shot Information-Extraction
sources.read_scope: Guidelines representation, training, ablation and limitations.
sources.citation_scope: Only the located preprint record; a consolidated conference citation total was not verified.
sources.useful_component: Provide label definitions, scope, exceptions, argument definitions and representative examples rather than only category names.
sources.transfer_limit: GoLLIE is fine-tuned to follow annotation guidelines. Its results do not prove that arbitrary current LLMs will follow our guidelines without testing.

sources.title: Chain-of-Verification Reduces Hallucination in Large Language Models
sources.useful_component: Separate drafting from verification questions and independently answered checks before revision.
sources.transfer_limit: The paper is not a scientific-role classifier. Our checks must be bounded to supplied evidence, not answered from model memory. Separate calls can still share systematic errors.

sources.title: Can AI Validate Science? Benchmarking LLMs on Claim → Evidence Reasoning in AI Papers
sources.read_scope: Task, prompting strategies in Figure 2, and long-context/error analyses.
sources.useful_component: Compare joint extraction against claim-first, evidence-linking and claim-by-claim processing; inspect links across distant passages.
sources.transfer_limit: Three-pass and one-by-one processing trade additional cost for task-dependent gains. Claim-evidence extraction is not the same as certifying scientific truth or classifying all our roles.

sources.title: SciGraph-LLM: Automatic Knowledge Graph Construction from Scientific Papers
sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract only; full implementation and prompts were not inspected.
sources.useful_component: The abstract describes overlapping windows and schema-constrained GPT-5 extraction of atomic claims, evidence spans, methods, datasets, metrics and numerical results.
sources.transfer_limit: A recent candidate, not established high-citation evidence. The reported evaluation uses ten LLM-KG papers; no validated PK/PD role-classifier claim is supported.

sources.title: Diagnosing Structural Failures in LLM-Based Evidence Extraction for Meta-Analysis
sources.read_scope: Task formulation and results/error analysis, including Table 6.
sources.useful_component: Evaluate whether variables, roles, methods and numerical effects remain correctly bound, rather than checking isolated extracted terms alone.
sources.transfer_limit: Its GPT-5.2 and Qwen3-VL results diagnose this benchmark; they are not universal performance bounds for those models.

sources.title: Synthesizing scientific literature with retrieval-augmented language models
sources.read_scope: System overview and self-feedback, retrieval and citation-verification methods.
sources.useful_component: Retrieval, reranking, cited synthesis and feedback-driven source checking for an external literature agent.
sources.transfer_limit: Best located in the literature-support branch. It is not a source-only proposal compressor or a validated classifier for the proposed roles.

engineering_reference.name: Google LangExtract
engineering_reference.limitation: Source alignment checks where text came from; they do not prove that a paraphrase is entailed or that a source claim is scientifically true. GitHub stars are not paper citations.

recommendation.minimum_useful_design: Annotation guidelines plus contrastive examples, schema-constrained atomic extraction, source-bound verification, then compression.
not_required_now: A separate agent for every sentence

proposed_label_guide.definition: A source presents an existing project state, background property or event as established. This label records how the source states it; it does not certify truth.
exclusions: A specific analysis outcome better labeled RESULT
An externally asserted fact silently adopted as a project fact
proposed_label_guide.disambiguation: Retain origin and source support. A literature fact remains literature-attributed.

proposed_label_guide.definition: A reported outcome of an identified experiment, observation, estimation or simulation.
exclusions: An expected outcome without a completed analysis
An interpretation that goes beyond the reported observation
proposed_label_guide.disambiguation: Preserve OBSERVED, ESTIMATED, PREDICTED or SIMULATED basis as stated; a predicted human curve is not observed human PK. Do not infer simulation merely from the word predicted.

proposed_label_guide.definition: A proposition explicitly proposed for testing or explanation, with acceptance not presumed.
exclusions: Any sentence containing may regardless of context
proposed_label_guide.disambiguation: Keep proposed, supported, rejected or unresolved source status. Separate a hypothesis from the later result testing it.

proposed_label_guide.definition: A premise or simplification adopted or proposed to make an analysis or model possible.
exclusions: A rejected or prohibited premise represented as active
Speculation that is not adopted for analysis
proposed_label_guide.disambiguation: A method's adoption can be factual while its substantive premise remains an assumption. Link them rather than upgrading the premise to truth.

proposed_label_guide.definition: A procedure, study design, analytical operation or implementation choice.
exclusions: A requirement silently treated as a performed procedure
proposed_label_guide.disambiguation: Keep PLANNED versus PERFORMED; preserve algorithm, inputs and applicable conditions.

proposed_label_guide.definition: An interpretation, consequence, recommendation or generalization drawn from stated findings.
exclusions: A confirmed causal claim inferred only from association
A new inference invented by the extractor
proposed_label_guide.disambiguation: Extract only implications present in the source and link their supporting findings where explicitly identifiable.

auxiliary_roles.OBJECTIVE: The research question, purpose or intended decision; preserve as the organizing project objective.
auxiliary_roles.REQUIREMENT: Source wording that directs or constrains the project; retain wording and provenance for Project Rules Agent without publishing a formal rule here.
auxiliary_roles.OTHER: Material text that cannot reasonably be classified by the main labels.
auxiliary_roles.UNRESOLVED: Role or meaning cannot be determined from the available context; preserve alternatives and raise a material gap.

classification_principles: A keyword is a clue, not a necessary condition, sufficient condition or retrieval-only exclusion gate.
Classify atomic propositions, not whole paragraphs. One sentence may contain multiple linked propositions.
Use the most specific primary role. RESULT is preferred over generic FACT for a particular experiment or analysis outcome.
Separate discourse role from evidence basis, assertion, source attribution and planned/performed/active/rejected status.
Use neighboring sentences, headings and referenced tables where permitted; headings alone do not determine the label.
No closed-world assumption: NOT_FOUND after a scoped search does not establish that evidence does not exist.
Retain project objectives first, but do not discard consequential restrictions, exceptions or negative results as low relevance.
Preserve all scientific details required by the existing CC005 profile; this label guide does not shorten that profile.
Never replace an ambiguous clause with a stronger, simpler claim merely to reduce output length.

proposed_internal_item_contract.note: Review-level example of fields; not a deployed JSON Schema or a replacement main.json contract.

fields.id: Stable item identifier within the candidate version.
fields.role: FACT | RESULT | HYPOTHESIS | ASSUMPTION | METHOD | IMPLICATION | OBJECTIVE | REQUIREMENT | OTHER | UNRESOLVED
fields.origin: PROJECT_SOURCE | SUPPORTING_MATERIAL | EXTERNAL_LITERATURE; identify actual document via source_refs.
fields.evidence_basis: OBSERVED | ESTIMATED | PREDICTED | SIMULATED | SOURCE_ASSERTION | ADOPTED_PREMISE | UNSPECIFIED
fields.lifecycle: PLANNED | PERFORMED | ACTIVE | PROPOSED | SUPPORTED | NOT_SUPPORTED | REJECTED | HISTORICAL | UNSPECIFIED; use NOT_SUPPORTED rather than REJECTED when the source only reports lack of supporting evidence.
fields.scope: Relevant population/species, matrix, dose, time, conditions and exceptions from the source; do not infer omitted values.
fields.source_refs: Exact source ID/version and span identifiers; quotes and locations are kept once in the audit record.
fields.relations: Only supported links such as TESTS, SUPPORTS, CONTRADICTS, USES or INTERPRETS, with target item IDs.

proposed_internal_item_contract.source_audit: Each span has a source file ID/version, exact quotation and supplied paragraph/page/table/cell locator. Programmatic character offsets should be computed and checked, not guessed by an LLM.
proposed_internal_item_contract.main_json_policy: Publish concise facts/assumptions/objective and necessary subtype/status information with audit references; do not repeat all audit quotes or formal rules in main.json.

contrastive_examples.text: Plasma samples were collected at 0.5, 1 and 2 h.
Plasma samples will be collected at 0.5, 1 and 2 h.
Human clearance was predicted to be 4 L/h under the selected scaling model.

expected.must_not_claim: Observed or clinically validated human clearance.

contrastive_examples.text: For the primary analysis, the unbound fraction is assumed constant across doses.
Do not assume that the unbound fraction is constant across doses.
We hypothesized that clearance would decrease with dose, but the analysis did not support this hypothesis.

expected.statement: Clearance decreases with dose; the source reports this hypothesis was not supported.
The analysis did not support the proposed decrease.
expected.relation: TESTS the hypothesis; no claim that the opposite is proven.

contrastive_examples.text: AUC increased more than dose proportionally, suggesting saturable elimination.

expected.statement: AUC increased more than dose proportionally.
The source interprets this finding as suggesting saturable elimination.

contrastive_examples.text: The target drug has no human PK observations in this project.

expected.must_not_claim: No human PK data exist anywhere.

contrastive_examples.text: Human exposure is the primary prediction objective; literature assumptions require review before use.

expected.statement: Predict human exposure as the primary objective.

english_extraction_prompt: Extract source-grounded scientific propositions before summarizing. Use only the supplied and permitted source material.
Organize the extraction around the project's stated research question and intended decision. Do not invent a project objective when it is missing.
Apply the attached label guide. Keyword lists are non-exhaustive clues, never automatic classifiers or filters that exclude uncued content.
Split compound sentences into atomic propositions while preserving explicit causal, conditional, evidential and contrastive links.
For each proposition, assign its primary role separately from its evidence basis, assertion, lifecycle and source attribution. Use the most specific supported role.
FACT means source-stated fact, not independently verified truth. Keep measured, estimated, simulated, planned, hypothesized and assumed content distinguishable.

Retain every consequential quantity, unit, analyte, biological context, dosing/time definition, endpoint, experimental unit, statistical summary, parameter definition, transformation, information status, matching relationship, condition, negation, scope and exception required by the attached scientific-preservation profile.
Attach exact evidence-span references from the supplied source registry. Do not invent quotes, file IDs, page numbers, spreadsheet cells or character offsets.

Use neighboring context and permitted cross-references to resolve ambiguity. If the meaning remains ambiguous, use UNRESOLVED and describe the material gap using id, field, status, needed_at and impact.
Retain the original wording of project requirements for the separate Project Rules Agent. Do not turn a paper's reported method into a binding project rule.
Do not generate new scientific hypotheses, fill missing parameters from memory, infer that absent information does not exist, or resolve source conflicts silently.
Return only the requested structured object. Keep statements concise; keep full quotations and source locations in the audit records. Do not shorten away scientific qualifiers.
english_verification_prompt: Review the candidate against the supplied original evidence and attached label guide. The candidate is a hypothesis about the source, not an authority.
For each item, check whether its source spans support the proposition, role, evidence basis, attribution, scope, conditions, negation and lifecycle.
Check that observed results have not been confused with planned methods, predictions, hypotheses, assumptions or implications.
Check numerical and relational binding: a correct value assigned to the wrong species, drug, endpoint, analysis or time window is an extraction error.
Search the supplied source coverage for missing objectives, findings, premises and consequential requirements; candidate-only checks cannot establish completeness.
Return item-level findings with evidence references and precise corrections. If evidence is insufficient, report that limitation instead of guessing.
A PASS certifies the reviewed extraction within its scope; it does not certify scientific truth, data adequacy or human predictive validity.

algorithm_proposal.action: Prepare permitted source text with stable locations, document type/version and source-coverage records.
algorithm_proposal.checks: Retain SOURCE_INCOMPLETE for unreadable or missing material; source ingestion does not prove scientific adequacy.

algorithm_proposal.action: Extract atomic propositions with the label guide and contrastive examples, keeping neighboring context.
algorithm_proposal.checks: Schema validation, label enums, evidence existence and duplicate span detection can be deterministic.

algorithm_proposal.action: Review fidelity and completeness in the existing dedicated review branches; inspect global conflicts after their outputs are available.
algorithm_proposal.checks: Routine items may be batched. Ambiguous or high-impact items can receive focused source retrieval and separate checks; all material items remain in the review coverage.

algorithm_proposal.action: Compress reviewed propositions and preserve role/status distinctions in the existing main.json and audit layout.
algorithm_proposal.checks: Do not rename an uncertain implication as a fact during shortening. No formal rule publication occurs in this step.

proposal: Keep one shared label guide and a small, diverse set of contrastive examples rather than long repetitive keyword lists.
Retain source coverage for every relevant section; use retrieval to expand ambiguous cross-references, not as the only recall gate.
Use code for output syntax, locators, unit tokens and relationship references; reserve LLM review for semantic decisions.
Benchmark a one-call extraction plus existing reviewers before adding separate classification agents or sentence-by-sentence loops.

During explicit repair reruns, re-examine the changed items and their affected relations, then retain the required global review. This is a proposed local repair strategy, not implementation of deferred project-wide rerun invalidation.
No rule in this proposal introduces a default model-call timeout or output truncation limit.
efficiency_and_evaluation.evaluation_set: Human-annotated held-out proposals and permitted attachments; split by document/project, not random adjacent sentences.
metrics: Per-role precision, recall and confusion matrix
Predicted or planned content incorrectly promoted to observed or performed
Latency and token cost measured with the same test set
efficiency_and_evaluation.acceptance: Thresholds need project review before deployment. No model benchmark or prompt A/B experiment was run for this draft.
efficiency_and_evaluation.model_change: Repeat the reviewed acceptance test when the model, API behavior, schema, annotation guide or source parser materially changes.
